required_execution_order: Checkout the exact controlled-run merge SHA as detached HEAD.
Run repeatable preflight and require PREFLIGHT_PASS_ZERO_RESULT.
Persist create-only RUN_ATTEMPT.marker before invoking measure_support_funnel on the real frozen payload.
Execute one and only one Track A/B/C support measurement.
Persist RUN_ONCE.marker last to commit the valid measurement.
Close 0053 to same-ID rerun, retuning and rescue regardless of PASS or FAIL.
interruption_rule: Once RUN_ATTEMPT.marker exists, recomputation under 0053 is forbidden. If the complete result/execution bundle exists but the final marker is missing, marker-only recovery may validate existing hashes and create the final marker without remeasurement. Otherwise governance closeout is required.
measurement_scope: TRACK A/B/C TRAINING-SUPPORT, SHADOW-SUPPORT AND FORMAL ACTIVATION DATES
TRACK A/B/C FORMAL ROWS, COMPLETE BLOCKS, TRAILING ROWS AND CALENDAR SPAN
MECHANICAL COMPARISON VERSUS IMMUTABLE 0048 SUPPORT COUNTS
explicit_prohibitions: NO ETH/SOL WINNER LABEL OR REALIZED MARGIN
NO PREDICTIVE MODEL OR CALIBRATION FIT
NO PREDICTIVE BOOTSTRAP OR CONFIDENCE BREAKPOINT
NO CANONICAL BRRK OR PHASE6 CHANGE
